page.content:
Judgment before Osiris: heart against the feather of Maat.

How Weighing of the heart connects

  • Location: Duat — The heart is weighed in Osiris' hall in the Duat.
  • Concept: Maat — The heart is weighed against Maat's feather.
  • Character: Anubis — Anubis tends the scale at the weighing of the heart.
  • Character: Thoth — Thoth records the outcome of the weighing.
  • Character: Ammit — Ammit waits to devour the heart that fails the test.
  • Work: Book of the Dead — The Book of the Dead illustrates the weighing of the heart.

What is Weighing of the heart?

In the Hall of Two Truths, Anubis adjusts the scale, Thoth records, and Ammit waits. A heart heavy with isfet is eaten; a balanced heart becomes an Osiris.

Key threads lead to Duat, Maat, Anubis, Thoth, Ammit and Book of the Dead.
